answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, config in pyproject.toml). Install with: uv sync --locked --extra all --group tests. This is the same as CI's `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all`, except that it also keeps the default dev group. To get everything including dev tools, run `uv sync --locked --extra all`.
answers.q2: uv run --no-sync bash scripts/run-tests.sh. That script runs `PYTHONPATH=./docs_src pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/`. CI uses `uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh`, which adds coverage.
answers.q4: CI runs pre-commit through prek, scoped to the PR diff. To run it on the whole repo, use `uv run prek run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`. The individual checks are: `uv run mypy fastapi`, `uv run ty check`, `uv run ruff check --force-exclude fastapi tests docs_src scripts`, `uv run ruff format --force-exclude --check fastapi tests`, `uv run zizmor .` and typos. scripts/check-style.sh bundles the mypy, ty and ruff checks: `uv run bash scripts/check-style.sh`.
answers.q5: Don't hand-edit these. README.md is generated from docs/en/docs/index.md by `uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme`. docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html is rendered from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml by `render-banner-sponsors`. uv.lock is generated by uv. The translated docs under docs/<lang>/ (everything except docs/en) are produced by the translation tooling, and the `ensure-non-translated` hook guards them. The language list is maintained by the `update-languages` hook. No vendored directories were visible in the files I read.
